approval_required_for: Any change or selection of numeric precision, quantization behavior, or numeric-policy assumptions.
Adding or materially changing a trusted template, template parameter, or design-space target.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record the failing or not_run checker, the affected artifact and constraint, and the unresolved binding in the review and gap matrix; hand off to input_preparation.cross_layer_sacg_gate. Do not promote an unverified binding or modify numeric policy, templates, or design-space targets.
executable_actions.rationale: Evaluate only the supplied numeric policy, template library and metadata, and design space against their named SACG constraints. Record unavailable detail as unresolved or not_run; do not invent formats, template support, or parameter values.

No trusted template coverage or template-to-parameter binding can be confirmed from the visible details.
The prepared-input errors list is empty, but that is not evidence that the numeric, template, or parameter-binding checkers passed.
The current SACG summary reports zero nodes and edges and no failed invariants; it does not provide checker-grounded bindings among these artifacts and constraints.
Model and shape artifacts are listed, but their relevant details are not visible here; numeric and parameter consistency against those facts remains for the integration gate to assess.
proposed_actions: Run the registered static numeric, template-coverage, template-binding, parameter-binding, and SACG checks against the supplied artifacts and record checker-grounded findings in the two expected stage-0 review artifacts.
Send any unsupported, incomplete, or inconsistent bindings to input_preparation.cross_layer_sacg_gate for resolution; do not alter policy, templates, or design-space targets in this review.
risks: Unsupported or underspecified precision and quantization assumptions may be carried into template selection unless the numeric-policy checker reports their evidence and status.
A design-space target may lack trusted-template or metadata support; this is unresolved, not evidence that a field or template is absent.
Parameter names, ranges, and bindings cannot be validated from the supplied summary. Inventing or assuming such values would violate the specialist boundary.
Cross-layer numeric compatibility with model shape, data order, and memory/implementation assumptions is not established by the visible evidence.
